game.name: Beach Buggy Racing
game.desc: Vector Unit's kart-style beach racing game, running natively on handheld Linux. The port replaces the Android runtime with a native one, built from its own ELF loader, a JNI bridge, an AAsset bridge for the APF asset container, FMOD audio over bundled SDL3, and GLES2/EGL resolved at run time by measurement.
